evals.prompt: Build an AI agent that calls a custom tool to look up orders
evals.expected_output: Declare a service with #[AsTool] methods, wrap in Toolbox, pass to Agent::call().

evals.prompt: How do I give an agent long-term memory across conversations?
evals.expected_output: Register MemoryInputProcessor + MemoryOutputProcessor backed by an EmbeddingMemory (needs Platform + Store).

evals.prompt: I want multiple specialised agents (research, support) routed by intent
evals.expected_output: Use MultiAgent with named sub-agents; classifier picks the right one.

evals.prompt: Make a tool method that the agent calls idempotently
evals.expected_output: Use FaultTolerantToolbox wrapping the toolbox; tool methods must be idempotent (use tool_call.id as key).

evals.prompt: Transcribe a 30-minute audio file then ask a question about it
evals.expected_output: Use SpeechAgent which wraps Whisper/Deepgram transcription + chat turn.

evals.prompt: How do I persist chat messages across HTTP requests?
evals.expected_output: (Defer to chat skill; do not load agent skill for this query.)

evals.prompt: Make a one-shot LLM call without any tools or memory
evals.expected_output: (Defer to platform skill; use Platform::invoke() directly.)

evals.prompt: I need to store documents in Qdrant for similarity search
evals.expected_output: (Defer to store skill; do not load agent skill for this query.)

evals.prompt: Expose my Symfony app as an MCP server
Let Claude Code read my Symfony app's logs and profiler
evals.expected_output: (Defer to mate skill; dev tool only.)
